assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, utilities and service inventories are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All affected moves remain concepts pending professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: They support generation and discussion only; every area result must be recalculated after official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Exact heritage, railway protection and park implementation control lines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Historical translations are typological; authentic relic locations and treatments require professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: No cleared building-condition, ownership, tree, underground-space or utility survey is available.
assumptions.impact: Retain/adapt/insert decisions remain a pathway rather than parcel or building determinations.

assumptions.statement: No verified prices, budgets, operators or government commitments are available.
assumptions.impact: Only lifecycle cost components and a data-completion method are provided.

assumptions.statement: Operational performance has not been measured because all scenarios are proposed pilots.
assumptions.impact: Adoption metrics are gates or baseline-required fields, not claimed outcomes.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 is not a verified Dazhongsi station-area location and is reported by Issue #1029 as materially offset.
assumptions.impact: The design is a transferable station-area typology; do not infer a real site plan until the official polygon arrives.

assumptions.statement: Four building polygons are diagrammatic envelopes for recomputation, not surveyed existing or approved buildings.
assumptions.impact: No demolition, floor area, height, ownership or engineering conclusion may be drawn.

assumptions.statement: Three raster images are AI-generated typological visualisations based on the spatial prototype data.
assumptions.impact: They are not photographs, site surveys, renderings of approved designs or evidence of existing conditions.
